newsitem.title: CHINA: COSCO Pac to buy 20 pct of LCH Bank.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pac to buy 20 pct of LCH Bank.

text.p: COSCO Pacific Ltd said on Friday it proposed to buy 89 million shares, or 20 percent of the enlarged share capital, of Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd.
COSCO Pacific planned to buy 20 million shares in Liu Chong Hing Bank from its parent COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd and 45 million new shares issued by the bank, it said in a statement.
The company will buy the balance 24 million existing shares of the bank from an undisclosed shareholder.
The purchase price and other details were not immediately available and a further announcement would be made later on Friday, a COSCO Pacific spokesman told Reuters.

The purchase was aimed to faciliate COSCO Pacific's diversification from its existing businesses of shipping, container ownership and leasing and terminal development into banking, the statement said.
